Three new modules: a Sparkplug B decoder for factory MQTT data, phone number checks and language detection.

- `sparkplug-b-decoder.wasm`: decodes Sparkplug B MQTT messages from PLC gateways, edge devices and SCADA systems into metrics with names, data types, values and times. Every data type is covered, including arrays, DataSets, Templates and property sets such as engineering units. Metric aliases are resolved with the map from the BIRTH message, sequence gaps are flagged, and `rows` gives one record per metric for history tables. It also encodes NCMD/DCMD payloads to send setpoints or rebirth requests back. Tested with real messages from an MQTT broker through a Neblex MQTT trigger, which passes the payload as `payloadBase64`.
- `phone-number.wasm`: checks phone numbers against each country's numbering plan (Google's libphonenumber metadata) and adds the country, the type (mobile, landline, toll-free, premium rate, VoIP), the extension and E.164, international, national and `tel:` formats.
- `language-detector.wasm`: detects the language and script of tickets, emails and reviews (69 languages) with a confidence score and a `reliable` flag, so messages can be routed without an AI call. A list of the languages you handle improves short texts, and text in a language outside the list is reported as such instead of being forced into it.

The other modules are unchanged. Every file is built on GitHub from the tagged source, byte-identical to a local `./build.sh`, with `SHA256SUMS` and a signed build attestation.
